text:
maya-docs: Tiny PR opened to fix Console observability examples. Two issues: heatmap legend still says `tracekey` and the cost breakdown example uses `estimated_cost` without currency. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/10111
kevin-eng: Thanks. Where are the examples located? I can patch the Rust sample and the dashboard caption in one go.
satya-ml: Runtime now standardizes on `traceId` and `estimated_cost_usd`. We also started nesting metrics under `telemetry.v1.metrics` for some batch events; worth calling out.
rebecca-sdk: I'll update Node, Python and Rust snippets. For Rust I suggest mapping helper: ```rust
fn normalize(ev: &Value) -> (String, f64) {
  let id = ev.get("traceId").or_else(|| ev.get("trace_key")).and_then(|v| v.as_str()).unwrap_or("").to_string();
  let cost = ev.get("estimated_cost_usd").or_else(|| ev.get("estimated_cost")).and_then(|v| v.as_f64()).unwrap_or(0.0);
  (id, cost)
}
```
lucy-ux: UX asks: change heatmap legend text from "Cost by tracekey" -> "Cost by trace ID" (sentence case). Update alt text and ensure screenshot caption includes exact string. If we change any UI strings, ping PMs.
maya-docs: I'll replace the inline examples with the new shape and add a 1-paragraph migration note explaining legacy names. Will also swap screenshot and caption.
link-bot: Link-check: presets anchor redirects -> 302 -> working but please prefer canonical URL /docs/console/presets.
rebecca-sdk: pushed snippet commits to branch; Node example uses `payload.traceId` and `payload.estimated_cost_usd`. Rust helper above added. Python uses dict.get fallback pattern.
ci-bot: PR #10111 checks: sample-lint failed (rust-snippets test: missing newline in code fence).
rebecca-sdk: fixing lint now. small follow-up commit with formatted code block.
kevin-eng: I pushed the dashboard caption + image alt text change and swapped to canonical presets URL. Also added note about `telemetry.v1.metrics` nesting.
ci-bot: PR #10111 checks: all passed.
maya-docs: Merged. Leaving thread open for any downstream guides that need mirroring. Thanks all! :rocket:
